sources.title: Using Cache-coloring to Mitigate Inter-set Write Variation in Non-volatile Caches
sources.snippet: In recent years, researchers have explored use of non-volatile devices such as STT-RAM (spin torque transfer RAM) for designing on-chip caches, since they provide high density and consume low leakage power. A common limitation of all non-volatile devices is their limited write endurance. Further, since existing cache management policies are write-variation unaware, excessive writes to a few blocks may lead to a quick failure of the whole cache.
